integrity: The proof is self-contained and its finite exact-rational checker supports but does not independently certify the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Three labelled states, irreducible stationary discrete-time chains, and exact count laws; no higher-dimensional threshold or robustness claim. Equivalent unindexed literature remains a priority risk. Only same-model checks were performed.
title: Three visits sharply identify a stationary three-state Markov chain up to time reversal
